hints.text: The wordplay is a rebus – a 'say what you see' clue – where the effect of wordplay is present in the clue, and the answer functions as the wordplay instructions! What answer could result in the weird effect in our clue (while also corresponding with our definition)?

This clue is an &lit clue, which means the whole clue is the wordplay and the whole clue is the definition. To work out how this whole clue functions as the definition, we'll need to fill in the blanks, literally.
